sources.title: Kummuh

sources.title: Sarduri II
sources.note: Reign 764-735 BC; conquest of Melid and Kummuh undated; battle of 743 BC somewhere in Kummuh, Assyrians won, Urartians pushed back across the Euphrates.

notes: Cliopatria has no Kummuh; the neo-hittite-states hull (me-04-a) holds the same land. The page gives no founding date, so the state starts at its first dated event (866). Ushpilulume's 805 appeal to Adad-nirari III and Hattushili are on the page but give no land. The Urartian tribute starts c. 750 (Kummuh page) and its end is read from the 743 defeat (Sarduri II page: Urartians pushed back across the Euphrates); the Assyrian tribute's end c. 750 is a bridge. The kingdom-of-urartu dossier (eu-19) does not exist yet. FIXED (reviewer's finding): in 712 Sargon II gave Muttallu only the city of Melid (Kummuh page; Kammanu page: 'Kammanu was annexed by Assyria and the city of Melid was placed under the rule of Mutallu'); the first version gave Kummuh all of Malatya Province. The 712 gain, the keyframe kummuh_-712, the 708 events, the war zone and the successor land now hold Adiyaman plus the Melid cell (about 6,830 km2); the Kammanu dossier carries the matching loss of the Melid cell, and its other land passes to Assyria. The 708 events are at confidence 2 because the region is a reading. The neo-assyrian-empire dossier (me-02) has no Kummuh events (tribute from 866, 738, annexation 708): route me-02.
